_description: The Moon's surface tier table — GENERATED by tools/pipeline/build-body-tiers.js --write (plan 27 step F). The scene swaps the Moon's map by the TT age of its epoch from `tiers` (ages in Myr before J2000). `kind` names what a map IS: the cited present-day map, or illustration — generated, or derived from the present-day map by raising the maria. The gate tools/verify/surface-tiers.js checks the files against `files`.

derived.note: the present-day map with its young ray systems suppressed (the positive band-pass inside a weight around each crater: Tycho, Aristarchus, Copernicus, Kepler) and, from that, the maria raised toward the highlands' albedo under a blurred low-albedo mask (the methods and their measured thresholds are in the script) — derivatives of the CC BY 4.0 map, labelled "illustration"

generated.note: procedural illustration rendered by this script from seeded 3-D value noise on the sphere (seed 20261104) — no third-party rights; labelled "illustration"

literature.elkins-tanton2011: Elkins-Tanton, L.T., Burgess, S. & Yin, Q.-Z., 2011. The lunar magma ocean: Reconciling the solidification process with lunar petrology and geochronology. EPSL 304, 326–336 — the flotation crust within ~10–200 Myr of formation.
literature.hiesinger2011: Hiesinger, H., Head, J.W., Wolf, U., Jaumann, R. & Neukum, G., 2011. Ages and stratigraphy of lunar mare basalts: A synthesis. GSA Special Paper 477, 1–51 — most mare basalts 3.9–3.1 Ga, the youngest ~1.2 Ga.
literature.stofflerRyder2001: Stöffler, D. & Ryder, G., 2001. Stratigraphy and isotope ages of lunar geologic units: chronological standard for the inner solar system. Space Science Reviews 96, 9–54 — Tycho 109 ± 4 Ma, Copernicus ~800 Ma (the Copernican system), Aristarchus ~450 Ma.

tiers.label: Before Tycho — the Moon without its brightest ray system, 109 ± 4 Ma (derived)
Before Aristarchus — without the Tycho and Aristarchus rays, ~450 Ma (derived)
Before Copernicus and Kepler — the Moon without its young ray systems, ~800 Ma (derived)
Mare flooding under way — the maria at two thirds of their present darkness (derived)
Mare flooding beginning — the maria at one third of their present darkness (derived)
Highland crust before the mare flooding (derived)
Lunar magma ocean under its forming crust (generated)
